tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch3:3-21↗ prop:riemannian-quotient-metric Let $(\tilde{M},\tilde{g})$ be a simply connected Riemannian manifold, and suppose $\Gamma _1$ and $\Gamma _2$ are countable subgroups of $\mathrm{Iso}(\tilde{M},\tilde{g})$ acting smoothly, freely, and properly on $M$ (when endowed with the discrete topology). For $i = 1,2$, let $M_i = \tilde{M}/\Gamma _i$, and let $g_i$ be the Riemannian metric on $M_i$ that makes the quotient map $\pi _i : \tilde{M} \to M_i$ a Riemannian covering (see Prop. 2.32). Prove that the Riemannian manifolds $(M_1,g_1)$ and $(M_2,g_2)$ are isometric if and only if $\Gamma _1$ and $\Gamma _2$ are conjugate subgroups of $\mathrm{Iso}(\tilde{M},\tilde{g})$. \end{exercise}
